data.one_liner: Hive cache store implementation for HTTP and Dio clients using hive_ce.
data.what_it_does: Provides a database cache store implementation backed by hive_ce for HTTP clients like dio and http_cache_client. It handles caching responses, status codes, and managing cache storage safely with concurrent access guards.
use_when: You are using dio or http_cache_client and need Hive-backed caching
You require persistent caching for HTTP responses across app restarts
avoid_when: You are not using a compatible HTTP client like dio or http
You prefer an in-memory-only cache solution
strengths: Uses hive_ce for lightweight NoSQL storage
Supports race condition guards and isolated Hive cache stores
Avoids loading all values into RAM using lazy boxes
weaknesses: Tied specifically to hive_ce and supported HTTP client wrappers
Limited documentation outside of basic usage references
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package and its dependencies to pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides built-in interceptors and flexible configuration options for networking.
